Original creative direction and user-authored text: Lorsieab2. Additional expansion: ChatGPT (OpenAI).
collection.description: An old rule forbids placing woven baskets on a particular stone, but nobody remembers why.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: An old rule forbids placing woven baskets on a particular stone, but nobody remembers why.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A slippery patch explains the practical origin of the rule.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: No danger appears, and the villagers begin to question the custom.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Young villagers ask why respect must mean never revisiting a decision.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The group agrees to revise the rule without mocking its history.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Several interpretations survive, and no unanimous decision is reached.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The baskets remain perfectly safe, prompting a quiet revision.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: A basket slips, showing why testing traditions thoughtfully matters.
